name: Oshtor
source:
The Imperial General of the Right. One of the Twin Shields of Yamato, along with [url=/c37801]Mikazuchi[/url].
His face is always covered by a mask.
He is skilled in both the arts of war and peace, earning him the trust of both the people and the emperor.
